# show

Changes the displaying of MACRO dialog box.

```ttl
show <show flag>
```

## Remarks

Minimizes MACRO, if &lt;show flag&gt; is zero.
Restores MACRO and bring to top, if &lt;show flag&gt; is greater than zero.
Hides MACRO, if &lt;show flag&gt; is less than zero.

## Example

```ttl
; Minimize MACRO.
show 0

; Restore MACRO.
show 1

; Hide MACRO.
show -1
```
